messages:
Nina (Docs): Quick coordination thread: finalizing v1->v2 deprecation copy + i18n extraction. Plan to merge English canonical content by EOD tomorrow.
Haruto (i18n): Which files are canonical for extraction?
Nina (Docs): Canonical: /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/index.md, /guides/migration-v1-to-v2.md, and all quickstart snippets under /examples/quickstart.
Bea (Localization): We'll need a single strings.json export. Please flag code literals so translators don't alter them.
Priya (SDK): For SDK snippets: add a leading comment `// DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` in JS and `# DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` in Python blocks. Also normalize example timestamps to ISO: `2026-04-01T12:00:00Z`.
Nina (Docs): Good. I'll add a section in the PR with extraction rules: keys starting with `code_` are literal, placeholders use `{DEPRECATION_DATE}`, `{MODEL_ALIAS}`.
Haruto (i18n): I'll add a linter to detect MM/DD/YYYY occurrences. Regex used in CI check: `\\b(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])\\/(0?[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])\\/\\d{4}\\b`. Will fail the build if any found.
Bea (Localization): Request two banner keys: `short_banner` (<=140 chars) and `long_banner`. Also `note_model_alias` for the small footer note.
Legal Bot: Please ensure the sentence that states the shutdown date uses the token `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` and not a hardformatted localized date. Legal to review English before translations.
Nina (Docs): Will ping legal on PR open. Also removing one screenshot that contained UI text; replacing with a localizable UI copy block.
Priya (SDK): One technical note: some snippets reference `model: \"rwd-text-2\"`. Add comment `// subject to aliasing during sunset` as `note_model_alias` in strings.json.
Haruto (i18n): For placeholders, I'll ensure the site rendering replaces `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` with a locale-formatted date at runtime. Translators will keep tokens untouched.
Bea (Localization): After English merge, the i18n pipeline will create language branches. ETA: 3 business days for FR/DE, 4 for JA/KO/ES. We'll do back-translations for FR/DE only.
Nina (Docs): Action items: 1) I'll open English PR with strings.json and `DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` markers. 2) Priya updates SDK snippets and opens companion PR referencing the docs PR. 3) Haruto adds CI regex check for date formats. 4) Bea readies language owners. 5) Legal reviews the timeline.
docbot: New PR template added: `docs/i18n-deprecation-template`. Use label `i18n-deprecation`.
Nina (Docs): PR title suggestion: \"docs: extract v1->v2 deprecation strings + snippet literal flags\".
Priya (SDK): I'll normalize examples across JS/Python/Go and add a small unit test that validates snippet parity in the docs build.
Haruto (i18n): I'll also add a smoke test that verifies the `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` token is replaced on the deployed page (Cypress check).
Legal Bot: I'll review the English copy once PR is linked. Watch for phrases implying SLA changes.
Bea (Localization): Minor: include `context_note` keys for tricky phrases so translators know intent.
Nina (Docs): Done. strings.json will include `context_banner_title`, `context_step_2`, etc. Keep context short.
Priya (SDK): One more edge: the quickstart contains an example error code `ERR_RATE_LIMIT` 1 do not translate error constants. Add to PR notes.
Nina (Docs): Noted. PR body will state: \"Do not translate code identifiers, config keys, error codes, or variable names.\"
Haruto (i18n): Running a pre-merge scan locally. Found one MM/DD/YYYY in `examples/old_quickstart.md` line 9. Marked as fix in the draft.
Nina (Docs): Fix pushed. Opening PR now and tagging everyone.
docbot: PR created by Nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299 1 label `i18n-deprecation`.
Bea (Localization): We'll queue translations once 1299 merges. Prioritize DE/FR for customer-facing regions.
Priya (SDK): Companion SDK PR will be referenced in 1299 to make snippet changes visible. I'll include tests that compare rendered HTML snippets across SDKs.
Nina (Docs): Target: merge English PR by EOD tomorrow, then localized rollout by end of next week. If any blocker in legal or CI, we'll delay banner publish.
Haruto (i18n): Acknowledged. I'll monitor CI checks and post results to the PR.
Bea (Localization): Acknowledged. Will prepare language PRs and back-translation notes.
Nina (Docs): Thanks all. Post updates here when PR is merged or if blockers appear.
